title: I built a medieval cavalry charge game with Claude Code – looking for beta testers
author: johannesjo
selftext:
Lances Down is a short-session browser game that also works well on your phone: you lead a squadron of knights, pick your moment, and hit the enemy's flank so their line breaks. One finger to steer, no micromanagement, a battle takes a few minutes.

How AI was used: Claude Code wrote most of the code, including the code that draws the art (no image generators), and helped write the story text. The music is CC0, by human composers.

Play in the browser (phone or desktop): https://johannesjo.github.io/lances-down/
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=de.thefrontend.lancesdown

What I'd love feedback on:
- Does the charge feel good? Is it clear when you've hit hard?
- What do you like and what do you dislike?
- Where did you get confused or stop playing?
